literal: What was intended / without saying / with those who grasp / others / limbs / one / they are like / indeed / different.
translation: Those who grasp what is intended without it being spoken, and those who cannot, may look alike in their physical limbs, but they are entirely different.
modern: சொல்லாமலேயே குறிப்பினை அறிந்து கொள்பவர்களோடு மற்றவர்கள் உறுப்புகளால் ஒரே மாதிரியாக இருந்தாலும், அறிவால் முற்றிலும் வேறுபட்டவர்கள் ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts those who can read intentions without words and those who cannot. The phrase 'குறித்தது கூறாமைக் கொள்வார்' refers to people who intuitively grasp what is in another's mind. The word 'ஏனை' refers to the others who lack this ability. Though both groups share the same physical form ('உறுப்பு ஓர் அனையர்'), the poet declares they are fundamentally different ('வேறு') in their inner capacity.
